download_kaggle_data: download kaggle competition or dataset data to a specified TFDS download directory
run_kaggle_command: run a kaggle CLI command via subprocess with error handling for 404 and missing credentials
download_competition_or_dataset: download and extract a kaggle competition or dataset from the kaggle API
get_kaggle_type: determine whether a kaggle identifier refers to a competition or a dataset
kaggle_dir_name: generate a filesystem-safe directory name from a kaggle competition or dataset identifier
